purpose: Frozen public controls for a secondary source-local normalized term-frequency density tie-break.
formula: For each existing normalized query group g, tf_g counts normalized body-word occurrences whose existing lexicalAliases(normalizedBodyWord) intersect the aliases in g. Count that body-word occurrence at most once per group, regardless of alias-expansion multiplicity. density = sum_g sqrt(tf_g) / sqrt(max(1, normalizedBodyWordCount)).
ordering: Lexicographic comparison: preserve the existing primary rank, then compare descending density only for equal primary ranks, then preserve original chunk ordinal. Never add density to or otherwise alter the primary score.
scope: Synthetic source snippets and relative file paths. Expected order is a consequence of the frozen lexical formula and existing primary evidence classes; it does not assert semantic correctness.
